independence: Original atlas and current frozen round-11 captures only for scoring. No other evaluator, root judgments or technical PASS results consulted. No model/source edits or native/browser launch. Revision count, effort, tests and budget provide no credit.
standard: Faithful finished playable game-model interpretation of the original atlas; no manufacturing certification.
decision: Narrow pass of the requested visual gate for this exact frozen artifact and capture set.

categories.label: Silhouette / proportions
categories.reason: The long low coupe stance, wheelbase/overhang balance, wheel size, gently crowned hardtop and rear-deck relationship convincingly translate the atlas. Pillar/window corners and some bumper contours remain more angular, but the overall silhouette is strong.

categories.label: Body surfacing / panel fit
categories.reason: Broad shoulders, panel boundaries, roof crown and predominantly closed wheel wells form a coherent finished game body. Residual flaws are soft lower swage channels, thin/abrupt trim connections and a small pink/bright upper opening in the front well. Close-up finish remains short of the atlas's polished surfacing.

categories.label: Paint / material fidelity
categories.reason: Candy, shell pink, plum, champagne ornament and cameos clearly carry the original identity, with visible fine-scale finish variation. The close-up grain can read as orange peel rather than delicate metalflake, and the gold scallops are more repetitive/bold than the original filigree. Shell-pink depth and candy reflections are also limited by presentation lighting.

categories.label: Wheels / chrome / cabin / detail
categories.reason: Wire-wheel weave, narrow whitewalls, tire relief, ribbed silver rear fascia, lamp detail, cameos and plum pleating make a convincing game-scale detail set. Dashboard, seat/trim edges, bumper corners and some small fittings remain noticeably simplified.

categories.label: Visible mechanism / component plausibility
categories.reason: Front arms, separate dampers, supported rams, rigid rear axle/links, pump rack, straps, cables and curved bay enclosures read as a coherent installed mechanism. Tall rectangular support towers and simplified cup/link interfaces remain less integrated and less compact than the atlas. This is visible game-model plausibility, not manufacturing certification; service removal is not penalized.

inspected_images.name: front
inspected_images.observation: Long low body, gentle roof crown, wire-wheel stance and grille composition form a convincing game interpretation. Bumper/body transitions and window corners remain simplified.

inspected_images.name: side
inspected_images.observation: Wheelbase/overhang balance and the mildly arched hardtop roof read well. Lower swage channels and pillar transitions are less sharply controlled than the original.

inspected_images.name: rear
inspected_images.observation: Deck-to-hardtop relationship and bright tail-lamp fascia carry the original identity. The C-pillar/window perimeter and bumper corners remain somewhat angular.

inspected_images.name: top
inspected_images.observation: Split hood panels and continuous roof/deck ornament are clearly legible. Gold pattern remains more repetitive and less delicately layered than the atlas; glare is a presentation limit.

inspected_images.name: front-detail
inspected_images.observation: Headlamp lenses and grille have convincing game-scale detail. The arch has a dark inner closure, but a small pink upper inner strip remains exposed; bumper/hood joins are simplified.

inspected_images.name: rear-detail
inspected_images.observation: Ribbed silver fascia, lens faces and rounded body shoulder read coherently. Bumper corner and deck-opening edge shapes are still more basic than the atlas.

inspected_images.name: cabin
inspected_images.observation: Plum pleated benches, wheel ring, side cameo and roof crown read clearly. Dashboard and small trim surfaces remain coarse; candy grain can read as orange peel in close view.

inspected_images.name: trunk
inspected_images.observation: Paired pump units, strapped batteries and reinforced lid create a coherent loaded trunk. Curved side enclosures fit the space, though the enclosure transitions and lid structure remain simplified.

inspected_images.name: bay-detail
inspected_images.observation: Pump bodies, wiring and curved inner enclosures read as an integrated installation at game scale. Fitting/hinge detail and transitions between enclosure pieces remain sparse.

inspected_images.name: hood-open
inspected_images.observation: Engine, radiator and curved dark inner-fender shapes form a plausible bay. Broad surfaces and shallow hood-inner reinforcement remain simpler than the reference finish.

inspected_images.name: front-suspension-service
inspected_images.observation: Intentional body-off inspection on stands. Arms, spring, separate damper and supported ram relationships are readable. Tall rectangular tower shapes remain schematic compared with the atlas.

inspected_images.name: rear-suspension-service
inspected_images.observation: Intentional body-off inspection. Rigid axle/link layout, spring supports and hydraulic rack form a coherent assembly. Tower silhouettes and component interfaces remain coarse.

inspected_images.name: right-side
inspected_images.observation: Confirms the balanced long low silhouette and gently curved roof on the opposite side. Lower panel channels and pillar corners still lack the atlas's crisp finish.

inspected_images.name: wheel-detail
inspected_images.observation: Dense wire spokes, narrow whitewall and tire relief read convincingly. The well is predominantly closed and dark, but a small pink/bright upper opening and angular inner surfaces remain; paint grain is coarse at this distance.

inspected_images.name: front-corner-wheel-off
inspected_images.observation: Intentional wheel-off inspection. Hub, arms, spring and separate damper remain legible and supported. Tall support cage and simple bracket forms are visually schematic.

inspected_images.name: rear-links-wheel-off
inspected_images.observation: Intentional wheel-off inspection. Rigid axle, links and spring seats have plausible visible relationships. Cup/link-end and upper-support detail remain simplified.

remaining_visible_flaws.defect: Small pink/bright upper well opening, angular inner-well surfaces, soft lower swages and abrupt trim/window connections remain.
remaining_visible_flaws.fix: Close the remaining upper inner-well sightline with a body-following return and refine lower swage and trim transitions. Preserve the current overall silhouette.

remaining_visible_flaws.defect: Paint grain can look like orange peel, while ornament is bold/repetitive relative to the atlas.
remaining_visible_flaws.fix: Make the fine finish read as restrained metallic sparkle under clear gloss, retain smoother broad reflections, and preserve more delicate layered champagne linework at game-view scale.

remaining_visible_flaws.defect: Dashboard, seat/trim edges, small fittings and bumper corners are still basic.
remaining_visible_flaws.fix: Refine the dashboard/instrument surround, upholstery edge finish and chrome corner curvature toward the atlas's slender rounded forms.

remaining_visible_flaws.defect: Tall rectangular support towers and simple cup/link-end interfaces remain schematic.
remaining_visible_flaws.fix: Bring tower/bracket silhouettes closer to the atlas's compact integrated mounting forms and add visibly seated cup/link details while preserving readable supported connections.

presentation_limits: All 16 actual native 960x600 images were opened. Aliasing and subpixel edges limit judgments about very fine seams/spokes.
Broad highlight glare and subdued chrome/environment reflection detail are partly the unchanged studio lighting, not geometry failures.
Grain character, simplified dashboard/tower shapes, remaining well opening and soft swage contours are visible asset-level limitations.
Intentional body-off and wheel-off service views on stands are not incomplete-vehicle defects.
This is a static visual gate. It does not certify handling, motion quality, audio or complete mechanical behavior.
The pass is narrow and does not mean the artifact is visually identical to the atlas; remaining visible flaws are recorded.
